contribution.position: My reliability position stands: the change is not defensible on this axis. artifact:perf-report shows peak-load run_time at 118s against a 60s budget — nearly 2x over — and artifact:incident-log shows two sev2 incidents last quarter from retry storms, precisely the failure mode an over-budget, slow report generator aggravates under load. The green suite in artifact:test-report (412 passed, 87% coverage) is unit-level correctness and says nothing about peak-load behavior. Settling the reliability question requires evidence that the 118s peak is remediated or demonstrably non-interacting with retry storms — load tests under realistic concurrency and retry behavior, plus a stated error-budget impact analysis.
